2. The teachings of the Nation of Islam strictly prohibit the consumption of pork and pork products, following dietary laws similar to those in traditional Islamic dietary jurisprudence (Halal) and biblical prohibitions found in Judaism and Christianity.
3. As a devout practitioner of these beliefs during his time in the NOI, and later as an orthodox Sunni Muslim (who also abstained from pork), Malcolm X strictly adhered to the prohibition against eating pork.
4. Therefore, ham, being a product derived from a pig (pork), was strictly avoided by Malcolm X.
